::: {#exm-pooled-variance}
#### Pooled variance of two small samples

With $n_1 = 3$, $s_1^2 = 4$, $n_2 = 5$, and $s_2^2 = 9$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
s_p^2
&= \frac{(3 - 1) \cdot 4 + (5 - 1) \cdot 9}{3 + 5 - 2}
&& \text{(definition of pooled variance)}\\
&= \frac{8 + 36}{6}
&& \text{(arithmetic)}\\
&\approx 7.33
&& \text{(arithmetic)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The pooled variance lies between the two sample variances,
closer to $s_2^2$, whose sample is larger.
:::
